comments.body: As a level 30 night elf, this NPC has no quest for me. I completed the Thandol Span quests, but not the Dun Modr elite quests, and she still did not have one. Did Blizzard disable or remove this quest, or is there some prerequisite or restriction that's not noted?

Update, did the dark iron war, still doesnt have quest available
